add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/Blocked|Malformed/i) ? 'blocked' : message.match(/failed|invalid credentials/i) ? 'failure' : message.match(/expired/i) ? 'denied' : message.match(/timeout/i) ? 'timeout' : message.match(/successfully|served/i) ? 'success' : 'unknown'

functions.description: Normalize severity, set protocol, and classify action based on message content

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start

functions.description: Alias Copilot/schematizer OCSF-style fields to canonical names
